## About
Country Tires, also known as Used Tires Roswell, sits on Alpharetta Hwy right on the border of Alpharetta. We stock new tires and used tires, and we carry a wide range of new tires from major tire manufacturers.
Our work isn't just replacing a simple tire. We balance and rotate tires, inspect them and fix flats. Any of our services can be done as a walk-in, and you're welcome to wait in our lobby while we work.

## Services
- New and used tires: Tires for cars, vans and trucks of all sizes, including new tires from major tire manufacturers.
- Balance and rotate tires: We balance and rotate both new and used tires.
- Tire inspection: Before any repair, we do a thorough inspection so the repair is done safely.
- Flat Tire Repair: We take the tire off the wheel to check the inside and outside walls for hidden damage before we repair it.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Any of our services can be done as a walk-in, and you can wait in our lobby until it's finished.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes, Saturdays 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We're closed Sundays.

Q: Where are you located?
A: On Alpharetta Hwy in Roswell, across the street from Carl Black GMC.

Q: Do you run any specials?
A: Ask us about current specials. Our promotions page lists free disposal when you purchase 4 tires.
